Class Column<E,V>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.Column<E,V>
Type Parameters:
E - the type of the rows
V - the type of the values
public final class Column<E,V> extends Object
A column of a table bound to an observable list with Ui.bind(javax.swing.JTable, be.imgn.swing.ObservableList, java.util.List): its header, the type of its values and how a row gives its value. 
Column.of(messages.lastName(), String.class, Contact::lastName)
        .editable((contact, lastName) -> contact.withLastName(lastName))

The type is what the table model's getColumnClass returns, so the table's default renderers apply: check boxes for Boolean, right-aligned numbers for Number. A null value shows an empty cell.

    • editable

      public Column<E,V> editable(BiFunction<? super E, ? super V, ? extends E> with)
      Returns a new column whose cells can be edited, with the table's default editors. When an edit is committed, on the EDT, the binding replaces the row with rows.set(index, with.apply(row, value)); the edit is dropped if the list no longer holds the edited row at that index.
      Parameters:
      with - returns a copy of a row with a new value
      Returns:
      the new column
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if with is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the type is not String, Boolean, Integer, Long or Double, which the table's default editors edit
